questions.q: What were the names of Benjamin’s first five sons?
questions.a: The names of Benjamin’s first five sons were Bela, Ashbel, Aharah, Nohah, and Rapha.

questions.q: What were the descendants of Ehud compelled to do?
questions.a: The descendants of Ehud were compelled to move to Manahath.

questions.q: Where did Shaharaim have children after he sent away his wives Hushim and Baara?
questions.a: He had children in the land of Moab.

questions.q: Who built the cities of Ono and Lod?
Who did the sons of Elpaal drive out?
questions.a: They drove out the inhabitants of Gath.

questions.q: Who were the sons of Jeroham?
questions.a: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah, Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri.

questions.q: Who was the father of Gibeon?
questions.a: Jeiel was the father of Gibeon.

questions.q: Who were the sons of Jeiel?
questions.a: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab, Gedor, Ahio, and Zecher.

questions.q: Where did Mikloth and his family live?
questions.a: Mikloth and his family lived near their relatives in Jerusalem.

questions.q: Who was the father of Saul?
questions.a: Kish was the father of Saul.

questions.q: Who was the son of Jonathan?
questions.a: Merib Baal was Jonathan’s son, and Micah was Merib Baal’s son.

questions.q: For what were the sons of Ulam, who were descendants of Benjamin, known?
questions.a: The sons of Ulam were fighting men and archers.

commentary.text: —Here is a larger list of Benjamin's tribe. We may suppose that many things in these genealogies, which to us seem difficult, abrupt, and perplexed, were plain and easy at that time, and fully answered the intention for which they were published. Many great and mighty nations then were in being upon earth, and many illustrious men, whose names are now wholly forgotten; while the names of multitudes of the Israel of God are here kept in everlasting remembrance. The memory of the just is blessed.
